page: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) about Hono. Answers to common issues and integration questions. Renovate configuration for dependency management in Hono projects. Official Hono team does not maintain Renovate config. Solution: use third-party renovate-config-hono extension. Configuration: extends renovate-config-hono in renovate.json. Reference: github>shinGangan/renovate-config-hono repository. Questions: Is there an official Renovate config for Hono? How do I use renovate-config-hono? Where do I find Renovate documentation?

sections.manifest: Renovate dependency management configuration for Hono projects. No official Hono team Renovate config. Third-party option: renovate-config-hono by shinGangan. Configuration in renovate.json: $schema: "https://docs.renovatebot.com/renovate-schema.json", extends: ["github>shinGangan/renovate-config-hono"]. Reference: github>shinGangan/renovate-config-hono repository for details. Questions: How do I set up Renovate for Hono? What's the renovate.json syntax? Where's the configuration source?
